summary: Frontend-only test (iteration 19) of the new multi-tenant Integrity page (/integrite) plus regression pass on Dashboard, Vehicles, vehicle drawer, Timeline and Alerts. All requested flows PASS. Login via demo-admin-btn works; nav-integrity tab present and routes to /integrite; summary reads '12 vehicule(s) . 3 lie(s) . 0 divergence(s) . 9 non lie(s)'; integrity-table headers Vehicule/Champ/LOGITRAK/Navixy/Statut with status badges (NON LIE / NON DISPONIBLE / IDENTIQUE / NON SUPPORTE). Filters: Tous=26 rows, Differences=0 -> integrity-empty, Non lies=9 rows all NON LIE, Indisponibles=11 rows all NON DISPONIBLE, Erreurs=0 -> integrity-empty. integrity-refresh-btn re-runs the check and repopulates 26 rows. link-assistant shows 9 link-row-* entries, each 'Aucun candidat prouvable cote fournisseur' + simulate-create-btn-*; NO 'Lier a ...' button rendered (0). One simulation opened (create-simulation-dialog) showing payload (label/model/reg_number/vin/type/subtype/tracker_id) + note on default car/universal, closed with create-cancel-btn only. create-confirm-btn was NEVER clicked. fill-demo-btn is fully removed from Vehicles; Vehicule/Consommation/Base technique/Exporter/Synchroniser remain and open working menus/dialogs. No console errors and zero HTTP >= 400 responses across the whole navigation.

issues: Recharts console warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' - ResponsiveContainer has no minWidth/minHeight, chart briefly renders in a 0-size container on mount (warning only, chart displays)
Radix a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' - add DialogDescription to the simulation dialog

action_items: Optional (non-blocking): add minHeight/minWidth or aspect to the dashboard ResponsiveContainer to silence the recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warning
Optional (a11y): add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to create-simulation-dialog and the other dialogs

Informational: the simulation payload for unlinked vehicles sends reg_number = vehicle label (e.g. 'reg_number: 1-Enyaq 01 Bern') and an empty vin. Verify this is intended before any real creation, since the provider would receive a non-plate value as registration number.
critical_code_review_comments: IntegrityPage.jsx: LinkSection returns null when the link-suggestions query errors (if (error) return null) - a failing suggestions endpoint is silently hidden from the user; consider an inline error state.
IntegrityPage.jsx: the filter 'keep' ternary chain in the row builder is dense; extracting a predicate map would improve readability (no functional issue observed).
Integrity rows use data-testid="integrity-row" (non-unique). Adding a row-scoped id (e.g. integrity-row-{vehicle}-{field}) would make future assertions more precise.
seed_data_creation: None. No data was created or modified. create-confirm-btn and 'Lier a' were never clicked; no document scan was triggered.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Useful selectors: vehicles list rows open via [data-testid=open-vehicle-<PLATE_NO_SPACES>]; drawer = [data-testid=vehicle-drawer] with tabs tab-general/tab-leasing/tab-assurance/tab-carte-grise/tab-etat-des-lieux/tab-controle/tab-documents (drawer is not a role=dialog, query by data-testid). Vehicles toolbar testids: add-vehicle-btn, conso-open-btn, astra-menu-btn (Base technique), export-menu-btn, sync-btn. Integrity page: divergences currently 0 for this tenant, so filter-DIFFERENT legitimately shows integrity-empty. NEVER click create-confirm-btn or link-btn-* (real writes to production Navixy) and do not trigger document scans (LLM cost).
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found; only two cosmetic console warnings (recharts container sizing, Radix dialog aria-describedby).
